A four-factor exploratory solution is discussed, but no complete item-level loading matrix for that EFA solution is reported in the provided text, so it was not extracted. Factor key mapping follows the printed Appendix 1 columns: F1 = Schwierigkeiten bei der Identifikation und Beschreibung von Gefühlen, F2 = Externaler Denkstil, F3 = Wichtigkeit emotionaler Introspektion. Varimax rotation is orthogonal, so factor correlations were set to 0 by rule. Female percentage was computed from 971 women out of n = 1859.
